ports.note: A table of counts per period in, one series or one per value of a chosen column; a table out, each period's observed, expected, threshold, statistic and signal under a measure column.

ontology.note: No ontology mapping yet. The receipt states the method, its settings and which periods signal; a signal is not asserted to be an outbreak.

changes.description: A limit measure, the decision limit on the statistic's own scale; the method's computation drawn in Configure…; Show me how for each method.

evidence.note: Unit tested against R 4.4.1's surveillance 1.25.0 on a 40-day series with five days of excess: EARS C1 and C2 thresholds within 7e-8 and identical signals; CUSUM sums within 9e-15, bounds and signals identical; EARS C3 differs on one day by design (R's bound leaves out the current day's term, Hutwagner's definition includes it); EWMA against its formula computed independently. No lab notebook yet. Nothing here establishes that a signal is an outbreak, or that a threshold suits a given surveillance system.
